description: An unknown `timezone:` fails the run with the exact `clock: unknown timezone 'Not/AZone'` text. The only clock case run as a document (rather than through clock.rs's own unit tests): every other `clock` behavior writes `meta.raw.iso`/`epoch`, the live wall clock at call time, which can never match between generation and any later --check/replay even on the same engine -- this one fails before producing a result at all, so no such field ever reaches compared state.
